episode_title: What It Really Takes to Sell Outcomes Instead of Software | Shiva Dhawan, Attentive.ai

real_qa.q: What accuracy level does Attentive.ai deliver for construction takeoffs and what is the revenue impact for customers?
real_qa.r: Attentive.ai delivers 99% plus accuracy on construction takeoffs. Customers using the platform can roughly 3x the number of bids they put out, which means their revenue at least doubles. The platform combines AI model outputs with human QA review to ensure final accuracy, with done-for-you service taking 24 to 72 hours.

real_qa.q: How does Attentive.ai's AI model compare to large language models for construction plan analysis?
real_qa.r: Foundation models like ChatGPT and GPT are trained on generic datasets and not on construction plans, so they lack the specialized knowledge needed for accurate takeoffs. Attentive.ai trains its own proprietary models on thousands of construction datasets from customers, giving verticalized companies like Attentive.ai a competitive advantage over large LLMs for construction-specific tasks.
real_qa.requete: LLM vs specialized AI construction plans takeoffs

real_qa.q: What is the addressable market size for construction estimators in the United States?
real_qa.r: In the US, there are approximately 300,000 estimators who perform takeoff and bidding work. With an average salary of $70,000 per estimator, that represents a $20 billion annual spend in the construction industry on estimation work alone.

real_qa.q: What are the three competitive moats Attentive.ai has built against larger AI companies?
real_qa.r: Attentive.ai has three moats: first, human-in-the-loop capabilities with a trained workforce, which requires complex operational setup and cost-effective talent—easier to build in countries like India than in the Bay Area; second, proprietary models trained on individual construction trades (HVAC, electrical, steel, etc.), each with unique nuances rather than one generic model; third, team speed of execution and ability to listen to customers and create UX solutions that solve their specific problems.

real_qa.q: How many construction trades exist and why does Attentive.ai build separate AI models for each?
real_qa.r: There are 16 trades in construction, each with its own specialty contractor (HVAC, electrical, steel, plumbing, etc.). Each trade has unique nuances in how work is estimated—for example, HVAC contractors handle only duct work and equipment, while electrical contractors manage wirings and circuits. Attentive.ai builds separate proprietary models for each trade instead of using one generic model, ensuring greater accuracy.

guest.bio_context: Shiva Dhawan is the founder of Attentive.ai, a company that uses AI with human-in-the-loop validation to automate construction takeoffs. He identified the problem that construction and landscaping estimators spend hours and weekends doing takeoffs manually, and built a solution combining proprietary AI models trained on construction plans with human QA engineers to deliver 99%+ accuracy outcomes delivered within 24-72 hours.
